title: VoxAngeles Corpus
underlying_source: UCLA Phonetics Lab Archive / CMU release
reason: Although phone alignments are manually corrected, the recordings originate in a pre-existing phonetics archive, violating the current primary-data rule.

title: It’s alignment all the way down, but not all the way up
underlying_source: Primary experiment, but relevant phone boundaries from MFA
reason: Recordings were manually segmented only at utterance level; phone-level boundaries used for acoustic measurements were MFA alignments without reported exhaustive manual correction.

title: Neural representations for modeling variation in speech
reason: Uses recordings from the pre-existing Speech Accent Archive rather than primary recordings collected for the study.

title: VoxAngeles unaudited subset
reason: Explicitly described as force-aligned and not manually corrected; also secondary archive material.

title: COVID-19 YouTube (COVYT) speech dataset
reason: Manual segmentation is present, but recordings were mined from third-party social-media videos rather than collected as primary research production data.

title: PodcastFillers
reason: Manual filler/event annotations are strong, but audio is pre-existing third-party podcast material.

title: Computed values for existing corpora / Buckeye-derived resources
reason: Derived measurements from the pre-existing Buckeye Corpus; not primary production data.

title: Second dialect acquisition and phonetic vowel reduction in the American Midwest
reason: Study reuses the Ohio State Stories Corpus. The original corpus is indexed once; paper-specific derivative files are not treated as a new independent source.

title: Prominence/boundary perception study in Journal of Phonetics
underlying_source: Buckeye and Corpus de Français Parlé Parisien among sources
reason: Even where TextGrids were manually corrected, the recordings came from established external corpora.

title: SpiCE Corpus phone/word tiers
reason: Orthographic transcripts were hand-corrected, but phone and word tiers were produced by Montreal Forced Aligner and documentation explicitly says inspection was coarse and involved no manual correction of those tiers.
